name: Reelix
description: One app for movies, TV, books, audiobooks and music: does the jobs of Radarr, Sonarr and friends.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your MOS storage (/DATA), one mount for downloads and media so hardlinks work. Your media is under /data inside, like /data/Media/Movies.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Reelix web app and API, published on host as 6726

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.
